baseline.method: Temporary final-source copy; only three runtime files replaced from baseline; identical final 12 tests

verifiedCases: Pending old-project save preserves its draft while keeping selected startup project
Delayed new-import save and actual IndexedDB revision-query transition cannot reactivate old project
New imported current project still activates after save
Committed same-ID restoration retires pending and queued writes plus stale in-flight failure
Latest hydration request/context owns result and errors; newer dirty status remains unsaved
Edits made before hydration are queued after hydration retires
Actual React project cards reopen both projects; fresh IndexedDB connection hydrates without extra write
Both saved Scene image references, scale, wall coordinates and private note survive; ZIP exact round trip

limitations: Actual React/jsdom project cards and PlanView; fake-indexeddb supplies the IndexedDB API
Owned two-JPEG backup; checks exact documents and SVG image references, not browser image/GPU pixels
Cloud project panel excluded; not real account, browser restart or two-device acceptance

limits: fake-indexeddb implements IndexedDB API; no real browser storage, reload/crash/quota or multiple real devices

Cloud panel omitted from local workflow; no real account/public URL acceptance
